Blades DashX360 background and transition-audio attribution

Motion and lighting adapted from BladeAmbientTexture.cs; blade tint values
from BladeCenterHost.cs in the user-supplied DashX360 project.

Original project by zivvoz / DashX360 - inspired by Microsoft's Xbox 360
Dashboard interfaces.

Source: https://github.com/ZivvoZ/dashx360
Inspected revision: 0c8adb2cef4ad7dff2bf889351efa1f1c244aef2
Paths:
XboxMetroLauncher/XboxMetroLauncher.Controls/BladeAmbientTexture.cs
XboxMetroLauncher/XboxMetroLauncher.Controls/BladeCenterHost.cs

The upstream README's "Working on the Project" section states:
"If you use this project, modify it, or build on top of it, please credit
Xbox/Microsoft, the project and the project's creator."

This notice records the upstream attribution and source. It does not assign
a new licence to upstream code or third-party assets. Xbox/Microsoft and
other rights holders retain ownership of their respective material. The
standalone application is independent and unaffiliated with Microsoft/Xbox.

Transition recordings in the separate artwork/audio pack come from
Assets/Audio/Sounds in the same pinned repository revision. Used files:
blades-switch-marketplace-to-live.wav, blades-switch-live-to-games.wav,
blades-switch-games-to-media.wav, blades-switch-media-to-system.wav,
blades-menu-open.wav and dash_2ndLevelClose.wav. Xbox/Microsoft and the
respective rights holders retain ownership of these sounds. Recordings are
converted to PCM16 stereo at 48 kHz; the XEX embeds none of these recordings.
